algorithm: AAC.
description: Protein representation based on amino acid composition, using the relative frequencies of the 20 standard amino acids in each protein sequence.
name: AAC

algorithm: ALBERT.
description: Protein sequence representation produced by the ALBERT protein language model.
name: ALBERT

algorithm: Google DeepMind AlphaGenome API regulatory predictions. signed log1p per summary feature, z-score across genes, PCA to 256 dimensions.
description: Gene-level regulatory representation derived from AlphaGenome predictions across multiple regulatory tracks around each transcription start site, summarized and reduced to 256 dimensions.
name: AlphaGenome

algorithm: APAAC.
description: Protein representation based on amphiphilic pseudo-amino-acid composition, combining amino-acid composition with sequence-order correlation features.
name: APAAC

algorithm: Basenji2 sequence-to-function model (checkpoint: Basenji2 PyTorch port). mean of central 3 output bins around TSS. log1p raw human central3 mean tracks, then dimension-wise z-score across genes.
description: Gene-level regulatory representation from Basenji2 predictions on 131-kb DNA windows centered at each transcription start site, summarized across the central output bins.
name: Basenji2

algorithm: BERT-BFD.
description: Protein sequence representation produced by the ProtTrans BERT-BFD model.
name: BERT-BFD

algorithm: BERT-PFAM.
description: Protein sequence representation produced by a BERT model trained on Pfam protein-domain sequences.
name: BERT-PFAM

algorithm: BioBERT-GeneProteinSummary (checkpoint: dmis-lab/biobert-base-cased-v1.2). final hidden layer mean pooling over valid non-special, non-padding tokens.
description: Biomedical-text representation obtained by encoding each gene's NCBI summary plus its UniProt protein summary, when available, with BioBERT and mean-pooling the token representations.

algorithm: BioConceptVec-CBOW.
description: Biomedical concept representation for genes learned from PubMed text with the BioConceptVec CBOW model.
name: BioConceptVec CBOW

algorithm: BioConceptVec-fastText.
description: Biomedical concept representation for genes learned from PubMed text with the BioConceptVec fastText model.
name: BioConceptVec fastText

algorithm: BioConceptVec-GloVe.
description: Biomedical concept representation for genes learned from PubMed text with the BioConceptVec GloVe model.
name: BioConceptVec GloVe

algorithm: BioConceptVec-SkipGram.
description: Biomedical concept representation for genes learned from PubMed text with the BioConceptVec Skip-Gram model.
name: BioConceptVec Skip-Gram

algorithm: BLAST.
description: Protein sequence-similarity representation based on BLAST-derived similarity features against a reference protein set.
name: BLAST

algorithm: CPC-PROT.
description: Protein sequence representation produced by CPCProt, a recurrent self-supervised protein model.
name: CPC-PROT

algorithm: deepNF: deep network fusion for protein function prediction.
description: Network representation built from STRING v12 interaction evidence channels using PPMI/SVD features and fusion into a shared low-dimensional gene space.
name: deepNF (STRING)

algorithm: DeepSEA sequence-to-function model (checkpoint: DeepSEA/predict from Kipoi).
description: Regulatory representation from DeepSEA-predicted chromatin and transcription-factor features for 1-kb DNA windows centered at gene transcription start sites.
name: DeepSEA

algorithm: DepMap CRISPR gene-effect matrix. Gene-effect matrix transposed to genes x models; missing values filled by source gene mean; model/cell-line features standardized across mapped genes; PCA with randomized SVD.
description: Functional gene representation derived from DepMap CRISPR gene-effect profiles across cancer cell lines, standardized and reduced to 256 dimensions with PCA.
name: DepMap CRISPR

algorithm: DNABERT-2 genome language model (checkpoint: DNABERT-2 117M). Mean pooling over final-layer non-special token embeddings. Long CDS sequences split into nucleotide chunks, then length-weighted mean of chunk-level embeddings.
description: Gene representation from canonical coding DNA sequences encoded with DNABERT-2, using pooled sequence features to obtain one vector per gene.
name: DNABERT-2
DRKG TransE
algorithm: TransE_l2 knowledge graph embedding
description: Knowledge-graph gene representation learned with TransE from DRKG’s heterogeneous relations among genes, compounds, diseases, biological processes, and other biomedical entities.

algorithm: Enformer sequence-to-function model. mean of central 3 human output bins around TSS. log1p raw human central3 mean tracks, then dimension-wise z-score across genes.
description: Long-range regulatory representation from Enformer predictions on 393-kb DNA windows centered at gene transcription start sites, summarized across central human output bins.
name: Enformer

algorithm: ESM2 Transformer (checkpoint: esm2_t33_650M_UR50D, as reported by Zhong). mean pooling over amino-acid token embeddings, as reported by Zhong.
description: Protein sequence representation from ESM-2 650M, obtained by pooling residue-level embeddings into one vector per human protein/gene.
name: ESM-2

algorithm: ESMB1.
description: Protein sequence representation produced by ESM-1b.
name: ESM-1b

algorithm: FRoGS-ARCHS4-256 (checkpoint: FRoGS ARCHS4 gene embedding).
description: Expression representation learned by FRoGS from large-scale ARCHS4 bulk RNA-seq data, capturing gene co-expression and transcriptional covariation.

algorithm: Gene2Vec.
description: Gene co-expression representation learned with Gene2Vec from gene co-occurrence patterns in large-scale expression data.
name: Gene2Vec

algorithm: GeneCompass Base, 12-layer knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model. none; static learned token embedding weight extracted directly from checkpoint.
description: Multimodal gene-token representation learned from large-scale single-cell transcriptomes together with promoter-sequence, gene-family, co-expression, and gene-regulatory-network priors.
name: GeneCompass

algorithm: Geneformer V2 316M input gene-token embedding layer. none; static learned token embedding weight extracted directly from checkpoint.
description: Static gene-token representation extracted from the Geneformer V2 316M input embedding table after pretraining on rank-encoded single-cell transcriptomes.
name: Geneformer

algorithm: GenePT-ADA.
description: Biomedical-text representation generated from NCBI gene summaries using the GenePT Ada text-embedding model.
name: GenePT Ada

algorithm: GenePT-Model3-GeneProtein.
description: Biomedical-text representation generated from NCBI gene summaries combined with UniProt protein summaries using GenePT Model 3 embeddings.
name: GenePT Model 3
GO TF-IDF SVD-256
algorithm: binary GO Biological Process profile + TF-IDF + TruncatedSVD-256
description: Ontology-based representation built from direct, non-negated Gene Ontology Biological Process annotations, weighted with TF-IDF and reduced to 256 dimensions by SVD.
license_note: Attribution, release identification, license notice, change notice, source link, and warranty disclaimer are required by CC BY 4.0 and the Gene Ontology citation policy; these are included in the package.

algorithm: GTEx RNA-seq median tissue expression matrix. TPM values were transformed with log1p, then each tissue column was z-scored across mapped genes.
description: Expression representation based on median gene-expression profiles across GTEx tissues after log1p transformation and z-score standardization.
name: GTEx

algorithm: Helix-mRNA (checkpoint: helical-ai/helix-mRNA). final token embeddings from official Helix wrapper, mean pooled over non-special sequence tokens; long transcripts chunked and token-count weighted.
description: mRNA sequence representation obtained by encoding full mature transcripts with Helix-mRNA and pooling transcript-level sequence features into one vector per gene.
name: Helix-mRNA

algorithm: Hetionet v1.0 heterogeneous biomedical knowledge graph. Built sparse gene x typed-neighbor-feature count matrix; collapsed duplicate gene-feature edges by summation; applied sublinear TF-IDF weighting; reduced with randomized TruncatedSVD; z-scored SVD dimensions across source genes; mapped to master by Entrez ID.
description: Knowledge-graph representation built from non-PPI Hetionet gene context, converted to TF-IDF features and reduced to 256 dimensions with SVD.
name: Hetionet (non-PPI)

algorithm: HMMER.
description: Protein sequence-profile representation based on HMMER-derived profile features.
name: HMMER

algorithm: HPA normal tissue immunohistochemistry annotations. maximum ordinal protein-expression level across annotated cell types within each tissue. HPA Level encoded as Not detected=0, Low=1, Medium=2, High=3. For each gene and tissue, maximum level across annotated cell types was used. Tissue columns were z-scored across mapped genes.
description: Functional representation from Human Protein Atlas normal-tissue immunohistochemistry profiles, encoding tissue-level protein expression patterns for each gene.
name: HPA tissue

algorithm: HPA subcellular immunofluorescence annotations. Main location, Additional location, and Extracellular location were parsed as semicolon-separated labels. A binary multi-hot location vector was created per gene, duplicate genes were collapsed by max, then location columns were z-scored across mapped genes.
description: Functional representation from Human Protein Atlas subcellular-localization annotations, encoded as standardized multi-hot cellular-compartment features.
name: HPA subcellular

algorithm: HyenaDNA medium 160k sequence-length checkpoint (checkpoint: LongSafari/hyenadna-medium-160k-seqlen-hf). final hidden-state mean pooling over non-special nucleotide tokens; long CDS split into chunks and token-count weighted.
description: Gene representation from canonical coding DNA sequences encoded with the HyenaDNA medium 160k model and pooled into one vector per gene.
name: HyenaDNA

algorithm: LEARNED-VEC.
description: Protein sequence representation learned with the unsupervised Learned-Vec method from amino-acid sequence context.
name: Learned-Vec

algorithm: Mahi context-aware gene embedding model. mean across all non-global tissue/cell contexts per Entrez gene.
description: Multimodal gene representation obtained by averaging Mahi embeddings across tissue and cell contexts, each integrating context-specific network topology with chromatin-accessibility, transcription-factor-binding, histone-modification, and protein-structure information.
name: Mahi (all-context mean)

algorithm: Mahi context-aware gene embedding model. global context only.
description: Multimodal gene representation from the global Mahi context, integrating global network topology with chromatin-accessibility, transcription-factor-binding, histone-modification, and protein-structure information.
name: Mahi (global)

algorithm: Mashup-STRING.
description: PPI/network representation learned with Mashup from STRING interaction networks, preserving integrated network diffusion structure in a low-dimensional gene space.
name: Mashup (STRING)

algorithm: MSA Transformer (checkpoint: esm_msa1b_t12_100M_UR50S). mean residue representation from layer 12; long proteins split into non-overlapping windows and length-weighted mean pooled.
description: Protein sequence representation from the FAIR-ESM MSA Transformer using depth-1 single-sequence inputs, pooled to one vector per human protein/gene.
name: MSA Transformer (depth 1)

algorithm: MUT2VEC.
description: Multimodal gene representation learned from mutation profiles together with biomedical literature and protein-protein interaction information.

algorithm: NEWT component embedding (checkpoint: not applicable). precomputed component embedding table.
description: NEWT network representation derived from normalized CellNet tissue- and lineage-specific regulatory-network connectivity scores, encoding each gene’s association with lineage programs.

algorithm: NEWT component embedding (checkpoint: not applicable). precomputed component embedding table.
description: NEWT component representation derived from Gene Ontology annotations and provided as a 256-dimensional functional gene embedding.

algorithm: NEWT component embedding (checkpoint: not applicable). precomputed component embedding table.
description: NEWT component representation derived from the Gene Ontology graph, encoding graph-based functional relationships among genes.
name: NEWT GO graph

algorithm: NEWT component embedding (checkpoint: not applicable). precomputed component embedding table.
description: NEWT component representation derived from MSigDB pathway and gene-set memberships, encoding shared functional-program context among genes.

algorithm: node2vec: scalable feature learning for networks.

algorithm: Nucleotide Transformer v2 (checkpoint: InstaDeepAI/nucleotide-transformer-v2-500m-multi-species). final hidden layer mean pooling over non-special, non-padding tokens; chunk-weighted by token count for long CDS.
description: Gene representation from canonical coding DNA sequences encoded with Nucleotide Transformer v2 500M multi-species and pooled into one vector per gene.
name: Nucleotide Transformer v2

algorithm: OPA2Vec.
description: Ontology representation generated with OPA2Vec from Gene Ontology structure and human GO annotations, embedding genes from their semantic annotation context.
name: OPA2Vec

algorithm: Orthrus mature RNA foundation model (checkpoint: Orthrus base 4-track). Orthrus representation() sequence-level embedding. For transcripts longer than max_full_len, length-weighted mean of chunk-level Orthrus embeddings.
description: RNA sequence representation obtained from full mature transcripts with the Orthrus base 4-track model and pooled to one vector per gene.
name: Orthrus

algorithm: PrimeKG heterogeneous biomedical knowledge graph. Built sparse gene x typed-neighbor-feature count matrix; collapsed duplicate gene-feature edges by summation; applied sublinear TF-IDF weighting; reduced with randomized TruncatedSVD; z-scored SVD dimensions across source genes; mapped to master by Entrez ID.
description: Knowledge-graph representation built from non-PPI PrimeKG gene context, converted to TF-IDF features and reduced to 256 dimensions with SVD.

algorithm: PROTVEC.
description: Protein sequence representation based on ProtVec, which learns distributed embeddings of amino-acid 3-mers and aggregates them into protein-level vectors.

algorithm: PubMedBERT-GeneProteinSummary (checkpoint: microsoft/BiomedNLP-BiomedBERT-base-uncased-abstract-fulltext). final hidden layer mean pooling over valid non-special, non-padding tokens.
description: Biomedical-text representation obtained by encoding each gene's NCBI summary plus its UniProt protein summary, when available, with PubMedBERT and mean-pooling the token representations.

algorithm: RNA-FM / rna_fm_t12 RNA language model. Final layer 12 mean token pooling over real RNA tokens only; BOS/EOS excluded; long transcripts split into chunks and chunk means length-weighted.
description: RNA sequence representation obtained by encoding full mature transcripts with RNA-FM and pooling sequence features into one vector per gene.

algorithm: scFoundation / xTrimoGene (checkpoint: models.ckpt). fixed checkpoint embedding table; no cell/context pooling.
description: Static gene-identity representation extracted from scFoundation’s learned gene-position embedding table after pretraining on large-scale single-cell expression data.

description: Static gene-token representation extracted from the official scGPT whole-human checkpoint pretrained on large-scale single-cell transcriptomic data.

algorithm: scGPT pan-cancer checkpoint (checkpoint: scGPT pan-cancer gene-token embedding). none; static learned token embedding weight extracted directly from checkpoint.
description: Static gene-token representation extracted from the official scGPT pan-cancer checkpoint, capturing gene identity in a cancer-focused single-cell model.
